options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name; each grid is named "{label}, {month year}".

options.name: definition
options.description: Working days (default Monday to Friday), hours (default 09:00 to 17:00), weekday hours, holidays, and exceptions. Validated (BUSINESS_CALENDAR_DEFINITION).

options.name: month
options.description: First visible month. Default: the month of the focused date.

options.name: editable
options.description: Enter, Space, or a click toggles a day between working and non-working (an exception).

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First column (1 = Monday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

options.name: today
options.description: Advanced: fixed "today" for tests and demos.

options.name: months
options.description: Consecutive months shown, 1 to 12; the previous/next buttons page by this many.

options.name: showLegend
options.description: Show the legend of day kinds.

options.name: showHolidays
options.description: List the holidays of the visible months.

options.name: locale
options.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA timezone of "today" (never the host machine zone, SPEC section 8.1).

options.name: direction
options.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: definition
properties.description: The current definition including edits (for saving).

properties.name: engine
properties.description: The engine of the current definition (day, isWorkingDay, addWorkingDays, workingDaysBetween, nextWorkingDay, previousWorkingDay, workingIntervals, isWorkingTime).

properties.name: focusedDate
properties.description: The day holding the roving tab stop.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; a definition replaces the current one (and its edits).

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show a date and make it the focused day (no events).

methods.name: setWorking
methods.description: Programmatic edit (no events): adds, or removes when redundant, an exception.

methods.name: createBusinessCalendar
methods.description: Module function: a validated engine without UI.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { date: PlainDate; working: boolean; definition: BusinessCalendarDefinition }
events.description: Edit mode: the user toggled a day; definition is the updated definition.

events.name: aui-day-select
events.description: The user activated a day (click, Enter, or Space), in both modes.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: The visible months changed by user action.

cssClasses.name: aui-business-calendar__header | __nav | __prev | __next | __range
cssClasses.description: Paging header and the visible range (live region).
